title: 弥生賞の後に・燃えたッ！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket faces the awesome sprint of Narita Taishin, but manages to win out by matching her rival's fearsome determination.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taishin, though reluctant to admit it, seems to have gained a new respect for Ticket's wholehearted efforts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She declares that she won't lose in their next encounter at the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket begins training to ensure she wins their next race as well.
